settings.heading: Q:  What are Popdarts?
settings.content: A: Popdarts are like darts, but way cooler - think suctions cup bocce ball in your house instead of pointy ends in a low-lit lonely pub. They're the best way to bring the fun without poking holes in anything but your free time.

settings.heading: Q: How do you play popdarts?
settings.content: A: Throw your Popdart toward the target marker and try to stick it on top for an elusive T-nobber (PRO/ELITE Pack) for 10 points and ultimate bragging rights! If you don't, the closest dart to the target scores 3 points, any others that stick get 1. Simple, fun, and a tad addictive.

settings.heading: Q: What surfaces are best for popdarts?
settings.content: A: Smooth, flat, and squeaky-clean surfaces are Popdarts BFFs. Tables glass, metal, mirrors—think slick, and you're good to stick! Good one, dad.

settings.heading: Q: How to throw popdarts?
settings.content: A: Think of it like tossing a paper airplane, it's all in the push! Lock that wrist and keep your Popdart flying steady, with no spins or rotations through the air. For a deep dive, check out our "How to Throw" page for pro tips and tutorials. Moral of the story? You'll nail it in no time, have a blast perfecting that throw, and who knows—maybe even be ready for our next $10,000 tournament!

settings.heading: Q: Are Popdarts safe for children?
settings.content: A: Absolutely! Made from 100% food-grade silicone, they're safe for kids ages 3 and up. No sharp edges, no worries, and best of all—Mom, they won't leave a single mark! Just pure, suction-cup fun that might make you wonder if this is the most affordable hobby your kids—and lets be honest, your husband—will ever obsess over.

settings.heading: Q: How many people can play popdarts?
settings.content: A: Popdarts is a multiplayer magnet! Play solo, 1-on-1, or gather a group to turn things into a friendly competition. No player limit—just bring enough Popdarts for everyone to get in on the action! One color per player. More colors = more players! More players = more crazzy shots!!
